youtube.description:
Zanetti or Facchetti: who is Inter's greatest ever? Our pick: Giacinto Facchetti.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate8 — the Italian Inter press in English every morning, free
THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.
Giacinto Facchetti (1961–78, No. 3): 634 games, 75 goals, 9 trophies — 4 Scudetti, 2 European Cups (1964, 1965), 2 Intercontinental Cups, 1 Coppa Italia; Ballon d'Or runner-up 1965; 94 Italy caps, 70 as captain, Euro 1968 winner.
Javier Zanetti (1995–2014, No. 4): 858 games (the club record), 21 goals, 16 trophies — 5 Scudetti, 4 Coppa Italia, 4 Supercoppa, Champions League, UEFA Cup, Club World Cup; captain of the 2010 treble.
Sources: inter.it, 110.inter.it, uefa.com
Fan-made — not affiliated with FC Internazionale Milano.
